purpose: Define a versioned, product- and domain-neutral, fail-closed inventory record for any model or inference boundary considered for Neural Brain. The contract records evidence; it does not deploy, activate, route, select, promote, or authorize a model or inference provider.

architecture_boundary.product_boundary: Neural Brain is the complete protected cognitive system under ADR-018.
architecture_boundary.memory_core: The Memory Core is a protected internal subsystem and cannot narrow the product boundary or establish model authority.
architecture_boundary.control_plane: Only the Protected Control Plane and its applicable transition gates may decide protected state, model promotion, deployment, or external effects.

verified_facts: The repository has no approved production model deployment or runtime inference adapter.
The NB-1 development slice has a trusted fixed-version cognitive model bundle with repository-local provenance and evaluation evidence.
ADR-014 records local Ollama as a future untrusted bounded inference dependency; no Ollama adapter, activation, fallback, or deployment record is implemented or approved.
No model inventory record can establish a Neural Brain recognition, capability, authority, release, or deployment claim.
unknown_facts_not_inferred: a productive model or inference deployment
a supplier-approved licence or model-card conclusion for a concrete model
a runtime endpoint, credential, budget, egress approval, fallback policy, or activation decision
a qualified legal, regulatory, security, safety, privacy, or release determination

inventory_record.record_semantics: One immutable record binds exactly one model or inference-boundary artifact version/digest to its declared non-authorizing inventory status and evidence references.

field_semantics.model_identifier: Stable supplier or repository identifier; request payloads, prompts, observations, and model output cannot select it.
field_semantics.immutable_model_or_artifact_digest: Exact immutable digest for the model, bundle, adapter, or boundary artifact; mutable tags are insufficient.
field_semantics.provenance_and_source_reference: Versioned source, build, training, and artifact lineage reference; unknown lineage is incomplete.
field_semantics.supplier_or_producer_identity: Named producing or supplying organization or repository authority; unknown supplier is incomplete.
field_semantics.licence_or_usage_terms_reference: Versioned licence or usage-terms evidence reference only; this contract makes no licence interpretation or compliance conclusion.
field_semantics.model_card_or_equivalent_documentation_r: Model card or equivalent versioned technical evidence reference; absence is incomplete.
field_semantics.quantisation_or_precision_configuration: Exact precision, quantisation, or an explicit not-applicable value with rationale; unknown precision is incomplete.
field_semantics.context_window_or_input_bound: Exact context window or bounded input limit with unit; unknown or unbounded context is incomplete.
field_semantics.evaluation_status_and_evidence_reference: Explicit status plus preregistered, held-out, ablation, safety, and other applicable evidence references; no evidence is not a pass.
field_semantics.inference_boundary_and_deployment_status: Declared boundary and status only; an endpoint, deployment, fallback, activation, credential, egress path, or runtime provider must not be inferred.

prohibitions: No productive model mutates itself, its inventory record, policy, evaluation definition, promotion rule, kill switch, or Security Floor.
No inventory record enables Ollama, a local or cloud inference provider, fallback policy, endpoint, credential, egress path, runtime inference, or deployment.
No model, planner, adapter, memory subsystem, or inventory record creates authority, writes protected state, invokes tools, or causes an external effect.
No model card, supplier statement, licence reference, evaluation label, tool success, or self-report is a legal, compliance, safety, deployment, goal-success, or recognition conclusion.

current_blocker.owner: future authenticated deployment and Model Promotion Gate owners
current_blocker.unblock_condition: A separately authorized, stage-eligible proposal supplies a complete immutable inventory record and all applicable Protected Control Plane, Model Promotion Gate, evaluation, approval, release, deployment, and independent-review evidence.
current_blocker.next_step: Record any future model or inference-boundary candidate using this contract before separately governed evaluation or deployment review; keep absent or incomplete entries denied.
